title: Airline Disruption Entitlements Scheduled for the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Three quantities decide what an airline's schedule message is worth to a traveller holding one of the Air Ticket Fare Brands. Tariffs and Distribution schedules them brand by brand.

**Schedule-change threshold.** The size of an airline schedule move, in minutes, from which the traveller acquires a change right under the brand held.

**Disruption rebooking fee.** The fee to rebook after an airline disruption when the move is below the threshold.

**Overnight hotel allowance.** The allowance reimbursed per traveller per night after a disruption.

| Fare brand | Schedule-change threshold (minutes) | Rebooking fee below the threshold (USD) | Overnight allowance (USD per traveller per night) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 180 | 125.00 | 0.00 |
| Economy Saver | 180 | 99.00 | 0.00 |
| Economy Classic | 120 | 75.00 | 125.00 |
| Economy Flex | 120 | 50.00 | 150.00 |
| Premium Economy Select | 90 | 50.00 | 175.00 |
| Business Saver | 60 | 0.00 | 225.00 |
| Business Flex | 60 | 0.00 | 275.00 |

## How the three move together

The threshold falls as the brand rises: 180 minutes on the two cheapest brands, 120 on Economy Classic and Economy Flex, 90 on Premium Economy Select and 60 on the two Business brands. A lower threshold is the more generous term, since a smaller move reaches it.

The rebooking fee falls in step and reaches 0.00 USD on the two Business brands. The overnight allowance moves the other way, rising from 0.00 USD on the two cheapest brands, where no allowance is scheduled at all, to 275.00 USD on Business Flex.

## Hypothetical boundary readings

An airline move of exactly 120 minutes reaches the threshold scheduled for Economy Classic and Economy Flex, and reaches it for Premium Economy Select and the two Business brands as well, since their thresholds of 90 and 60 minutes are smaller; it does not reach the 180 minutes scheduled for Basic Economy Lite or Economy Saver. A move of 179 minutes falls short of the 180 scheduled for those two brands, while a move of 180 minutes reaches it exactly.
